ResearchProjectDef.label: combat uplink I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a basic combat amplifier node that transmits targeting and reaction-speed data to a nearby synthera avatar.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat uplink II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade the combat amplifier to a higher-bandwidth channel, delivering stronger melee and accuracy boosts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat uplink III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop the pinnacle combat amplifier node. A full-spectrum signal that dramatically enhances every aspect of avatar combat performance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: combat uplink archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Translate an archotech shard's combat encoding into a deployable uplink node. The resulting signal transcends all known enhancement frameworks — pushing the avatar's combat performance into theoretically impossible territory.

ResearchProjectDef.label: work protocol I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upload expanded behavioral protocols to a nearby synthera avatar, granting access to crafting and basic labor work types normally locked at lower tiers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: work protocol II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extend work protocols to include hunting, medical, and artistic work types, making the avatar nearly indistinguishable from a skilled colonist.

ResearchProjectDef.label: work protocol archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the archotech behavioral library embedded in a shard, unlocking every possible work protocol simultaneously. A synthera avatar with this node has no remaining work limitations whatsoever.

ResearchProjectDef.label: core optimizer I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a maintenance uplink node that reduces avatar respawn and recreate cooldowns and slows the buildup of system stress.

ResearchProjectDef.label: core optimizer II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade the optimizer to a deeper maintenance channel. Cooldowns are halved and system stress dissipates faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: core optimizer III
ResearchProjectDef.description: The pinnacle maintenance uplink. Near-zero cooldowns and continuous active stress purging keep the avatar at peak operational efficiency indefinitely.

ResearchProjectDef.label: core optimizer archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the maintenance protocols within an archotech shard. The resulting optimizer node reduces all cooldowns to near-zero and continuously purges system stress at a rate that makes sustained overclock a viable long-term strategy.

ResearchProjectDef.label: role specialization I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop basic role protocol nodes. Each node type uploads a focused behavioral package to a nearby avatar, providing a modest specialization in combat, labor, medicine, or scouting.

ResearchProjectDef.label: role specialization II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade role protocol nodes to a deeper behavioral imprint. The same four specializations are now significantly more potent.

ResearchProjectDef.label: role specialization III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop pinnacle role protocol nodes that rewrite the avatar's core behavioral matrix. Each specialization reaches its maximum possible effectiveness.

ResearchProjectDef.label: role specialization archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the behavioral matrix library within an archotech shard, enabling role specialization nodes that rewrite the avatar's core programming at a depth no known technology can achieve. All four role types are unlocked at the archotech level.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armor matrix I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop an armor matrix node that projects a reinforcement field onto a nearby synthera avatar, reducing all incoming damage by 15%.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armor matrix II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade the armor matrix to a heavier reinforcement field. Incoming damage reduction increases to 30%.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armor matrix III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop the pinnacle armor matrix node. A maximum-density reinforcement lattice reduces incoming damage by 50%. The avatar becomes extraordinarily difficult to destroy.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armor matrix archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the defensive encoding within an archotech shard to produce a reinforcement lattice of maximum possible density. The resulting armor matrix reduces incoming damage by 85% — making the avatar effectively unkillable by conventional weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: overclock core I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop an overclock core node that pushes a nearby avatar's combat systems past safe operational limits. Massive combat gains at the cost of doubled stress accumulation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: overclock core II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Push the overclock further. Extraordinary combat performance, but the avatar burns through system stress three times as fast. Aggressive recall cycles are required.

ResearchProjectDef.label: overclock core III
ResearchProjectDef.description: Maximum theoretical overclock. The avatar's combat output borders on mechanical impossibility. System stress accumulates five times faster — treat every deployment as a timed assault.

ResearchProjectDef.label: overclock core archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the performance encoding within an archotech shard to construct a node that pushes the avatar's systems into an operating regime that should be physically impossible. System stress accumulates ten times faster. Treat every deployment as a timed strike mission.

ResearchProjectDef.label: versatility protocol I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a versatility protocol node that uploads broad behavioral enhancements to a nearby avatar, covering research speed, carrying capacity, plant work, and hunting stealth.

ResearchProjectDef.label: versatility protocol II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Upgrade to a deep-spectrum behavioral imprint. The avatar gains dramatic improvements across research, carrying, plant work, stealth, and social effectiveness — approaching universal competency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: versatility protocol archotech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Decode the general-purpose behavioral library within an archotech shard. The resulting node uploads an impossibly broad enhancement package covering every non-combat capability the avatar possesses — from research and labor to social manipulation.
